Duetto at theGATE Festival 2026

From

18 May 2026

To

22 May 2026

Location

High-Performance Computing Center Stuttgart

As part of theGATE Festival 2026, Duetto was presented as an exploration of the relationship between artificial intelligence and human movement. The project resonated strongly with the context of theGATE, a festival dedicated to the convergence of science, technology, arts and society, and to the new forms of cultural experimentation emerging at their intersections.

Duetto was accompanied by an interactive installation inviting the public to engage directly with a dancing AI. Visitors did not only observe the project, but entered a live encounter with it, experiencing movement as a space of exchange between human presence and machine interpretation.

By bringing together artistic research, scientific inquiry and technological experimentation, Duetto offered an example of how collaborations across disciplines can generate new questions, new forms, and new ways of imagining the relationship between humans and intelligent systems — approaching the body not as something to be reduced to data, but as a living source of knowledge, creativity and transformation.
